description: Skeleton scenarios generated from traceability.md (grouped, keyed by scenario id).

P01_no_fabricated_params.title: No fabricated parameters
P01_no_fabricated_params.notes: Validates SPEC_PC01/SPEC_PC02 baseline at query boundary: unknown parameters must remain undeclared/NOT_SET, and parameter identity is case-sensitive (no fabricated alias).

P02_dynamic_typing_rules.title: Dynamic typing rules
P02_dynamic_typing_rules.notes: Validates SPEC_PC03: static parameters reject incompatible type updates, while dynamic parameters permit type changes. Verifies state remains unchanged for static rejection and transitions to new type/value for dynamic acceptance.

P03_redeclaration_fails.title: Redeclaration fails
P03_redeclaration_fails.notes: Declaring the same parameter twice must fail deterministically. Outcomes recorded in op_end.detail; second declare triggers rclcpp ParameterAlreadyDeclaredException.

P04_no_partial_application.title: No partial application
P04_no_partial_application.notes: Atomic batch-set with one undeclared param must reject entirely. Uses set_parameters_atomically; state verified with get_param before/after. Both params remain unchanged on rejection. Validates SPEC_PC05+SPEC_P04 atomicity.

P05_readonly_enforcement.title: Read-only enforcement
P05_readonly_enforcement.notes: Validates SPEC_PC05: parameters declared read-only cannot be modified. Descriptor with read_only=true passed to declare_param; subsequent set_param must fail and leave value unchanged.

P06_unknown_params_rejected.title: Unknown params rejected
P06_unknown_params_rejected.notes: Setting an undeclared parameter must be rejected by the node. Outcome recorded in op_end.detail; node is constructed with allow_undeclared_parameters(false) pinned in NodeOptions.

P07_change_record_ordering.title: Change record ordering
P07_change_record_ordering.notes: Probe-only ordering signature after SPEC_PC07 retirement: sequential writes should be immediately observable in order via readback on the same key. No closure-critical /parameter_events assertions are made here.

P08_unknown_types_not_set.title: Unknown types NOT_SET
P08_unknown_types_not_set.notes: Validates that querying an undeclared parameter returns NOT_SET type. get_param op implements GetParameters semantics: has_parameter() returns false -> declared:false, type:NOT_SET.

P09_atomic_updates.title: Atomic updates (external)
P09_atomic_updates.notes: Validates SPEC_P04 external atomicity: when a mixed batch fails (one target is read-only), no externally observable partial state is applied.

P10_rejected_updates_silent.title: Rejected updates silent
P10_rejected_updates_silent.notes: Direct validation for rejection-silence using parameter_event observation: rejected type-mismatch update must not produce a parameter_event and must leave value unchanged.

P11_events_describe_changes.title: Events describe changes
P11_events_describe_changes.notes: Direct validation for SPEC_P05: successful updates must emit parameter_event records with changed parameter payloads reflecting value/type transitions.

P12_describe_unknown_consistent.title: Describe Unknown Consistent
P12_describe_unknown_consistent.notes: Validates bounded SPEC_P06 profile: repeated describe_param calls on the same unknown key return a stable default descriptor shape, and the query path does not mutate unrelated declared state.

P13_list_complete_stable.title: List complete and stable
P13_list_complete_stable.notes: Direct validation for SPEC_P07: list_params with prefix/depth filters returns complete and stable names across repeated calls.

P14_deletion_reported_events.title: Deletion observable and event behavior stable
P14_deletion_reported_events.notes: Declared-key deletion profile for rewritten SPEC_PC08/SPEC_P08: undeclare removes parameter state; measured Jazzy profile emits no delete event.

P15_parameter_interface_conformity.title: Parameter Interface Conformity
P15_parameter_interface_conformity.notes: Proxy validation for SPEC_P01 with bounded negative checks: confirms executable behavior across declare/describe/get/set/set_batch/list/get_parameter_types/undeclare surfaces, then verifies post-undeclare strict-mode rejection paths remain coherent.

P16_explicit_declaration_mode.title: Explicit Declaration Mode
P16_explicit_declaration_mode.notes: Validates SPEC_P02 baseline mode (allow_undeclared_parameters=false): undeclared sets fail, declared sets succeed.

P17_non_atomic_batch_callback_rejection.title: Non-Atomic Batch Set with Callback Rejection
P17_non_atomic_batch_callback_rejection.notes: Validates non-atomic batch semantics: callback rejection can partially apply accepted earlier keys while rejected keys remain unchanged.

P18_atomic_batch_callback_rejection.title: Atomic Batch Set with Callback Rejection
P18_atomic_batch_callback_rejection.notes: Validates atomic batch semantics: callback rejection yields failed operation and preserves pre-existing values for all requested keys.

P19_pre_set_removal_semantics.title: Pre-Set Callback Removal Semantics
P19_pre_set_removal_semantics.notes: Discovery scenario: measures pre-set callback behavior when a parameter is removed from an atomic batch.

P20_parameter_event_cardinality_batch.title: Parameter Event Cardinality for Atomic Batch
P20_parameter_event_cardinality_batch.notes: Probe-only signature for #1970 tracking after SPEC_P05.P2 retirement: atomic batch grouped event vs non-atomic per-parameter events on a tested 3-key path.

P21_descriptor_tracks_value_type.title: Descriptor type tracks value type after dynamic set
P21_descriptor_tracks_value_type.notes: Validates SPEC_PC09: after setting a dynamically typed parameter to a different type, describe_parameters must report the new type. Hypothesis: rclcpp updates descriptor.type on set.

P22_explicit_descriptor_type_enforcement.title: Explicit ParameterDescriptor.type enforcement on declare
P22_explicit_descriptor_type_enforcement.notes: Validates SPEC_PC10 using a positive+negative pair: explicit descriptor.type is preserved on declaration and a mismatched set attempt is rejected with the original typed value preserved.

P23_declare_without_default.title: Declare static-typed parameter without default value
P23_declare_without_default.notes: Validates SPEC_PC11: declaring a parameter without a default must not unconditionally raise. Requires declare_param to support omitting value. Hypothesis: rclcpp allows declaration without default, parameter starts as NOT_SET.

P24_get_parameter_types_response_length.title: GetParameterTypes response length matches request
P24_get_parameter_types_response_length.notes: Spec-conformance test against official GetParameterTypes contract: response must preserve 1:1 request mapping, including undeclared names (NOT_SET entries) instead of collapsing to error/empty array.

P25_concurrent_visibility_probe.title: Concurrent visibility during non-atomic single-call batch set
P25_concurrent_visibility_probe.notes: Issue-equivalent probe for lock/visibility claim: repeated single non-atomic set_parameters calls under concurrent reads. Baseline expectation is mixed old/new cross-key snapshots on the measured path.

P26_type_coercion_matrix.title: Type coercion matrix for static and dynamic parameters
P26_type_coercion_matrix.notes: Non-happy-path coercion matrix: static typed parameters must reject cross-type sets (double->int, bool->int, int->bool) and preserve prior value. Dynamic-typed control path confirms explicit type transitions succeed without implicit coercion.

P27_standard_batch_partial_application_c.title: Standard Batch Partial Application Check
P27_standard_batch_partial_application_c.notes: Validates sequential non-atomic batch semantics: when a later key is rejected by validation callback, earlier accepted keys remain applied.

P28_atomic_batch_transaction_check.title: Atomic Batch Transaction Check
P28_atomic_batch_transaction_check.notes: Validates transactional all-or-nothing semantics: callback rejection fails the atomic request and preserves all prior values.

P29_callback_storage_old_value_visibilit.title: Callback Storage Old-Value Visibility
P29_callback_storage_old_value_visibilit.notes: Validates callback-time visibility: callback receives proposed value while storage still exposes old committed value during validation.

P30_external_visibility_after_success_on.title: External Visibility After Success Only
P30_external_visibility_after_success_on.notes: Validates observer-facing timing: rejected updates remain externally silent, and visibility occurs only after a successful commit.

P33_standard_batch_partial_application_t.title: Standard Batch Partial Application (Type Failure)
P33_standard_batch_partial_application_t.notes: Result-first standard profile check: non-atomic batch applies earlier valid update and does not roll it back when a later element fails type validation; callback-time storage for the first key must still read old committed value.

P34_atomic_batch_transaction_integrity_t.title: Atomic Batch Transaction Integrity (Type Failure)
P34_atomic_batch_transaction_integrity_t.notes: Result-first atomic profile check: atomic batch with mixed valid/invalid elements must reject as a unit and preserve all prior values.

P35_concurrent_visibility_atomic_control.title: Concurrent visibility control for atomic single-call batch set
P35_concurrent_visibility_atomic_control.notes: Control probe for lock/visibility axis: repeated single atomic set_parameters_atomically calls under concurrent reads. Mixed old/new snapshot across target keys is forbidden.

P31_no_default_with_startup_override.title: No-default declaration resolves CLI startup override
P31_no_default_with_startup_override.notes: Issue-equivalent path for rclpy#1460 using CLI args (`--ros-args -p key:=value`): typed declaration without default must bind CLI override value.

P32_startup_declare_event_batching.title: Startup declaration event signature probe
P32_startup_declare_event_batching.notes: Issue-signature probe for startup declaration event shape. This scenario records event signature fields without enforcing a normative batching contract.

P36_integer_descriptor_range_enforcement.title: Integer descriptor range is enforced on set
P36_integer_descriptor_range_enforcement.notes: Issue-equivalent closure probe for rclcpp#728: integer range constraints from ParameterDescriptor are enforced and out-of-range writes are rejected.

P37_floating_descriptor_range_enforcemen.title: Floating-point descriptor range is enforced on set
P37_floating_descriptor_range_enforcemen.notes: Issue-equivalent closure probe for rclcpp#728: floating-point range constraints from ParameterDescriptor are enforced and out-of-range writes are rejected.

P38_undeclared_allowed_implicit_declarat.title: Undeclared-allowed mode implicitly declares on set
P38_undeclared_allowed_implicit_declarat.notes: Validates undeclared-allowed branch for SPEC_PC06/SPEC_P02: setting an unknown key succeeds, implicitly declares the key, and makes it visible via get/list/get_parameter_types.

P41_no_premature_visibility_before_commi.title: No premature visibility before commit (control)
P41_no_premature_visibility_before_commi.notes: Control pair for P29: callback is intentionally configured with a counterfactual expected_old_value to prove commit has not happened yet. Set must be rejected by callback and no external change event should be emitted.

P42_unknown_delete_safe_no_corruption.title: Unknown delete is safe and non-corrupting
P42_unknown_delete_safe_no_corruption.notes: Validates bounded deletion safety profile for SPEC_PC08/SPEC_P08: undeclare on unknown key fails safely, emits no event, and does not mutate existing declared keys.
